title: Always-On Load Growth
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue (`emporia:circuit`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, and smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=emporia:circuit circuit="Always On"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(power_w) as avg_w by _time
| streamstats window=4 current=f avg(avg_w) as baseline
| where baseline>0 AND avg_w>baseline*1.15
| sort - avg_w
description: Tracks the housekeeping load for your always-on circuit and warns when routers, chargers, media gear, or mystery boxes have nudged it upward.
value: Even a small always-on increase compounds across the year; trend-based visibility keeps creeping household power draw from hiding in plain sight.
implementation: Forward circuit power telemetry and label your always-on loads; review the weekly baseline and investigate sustained growth.
visualization: Weekly chart of always-on circuit wattage versus rolling baseline.
grandmaExplanation: It measures when the little things that stay on all the time start using more power than they used to.
